findings.rationale: The existing a4 target compares SN1/SN2 mechanism sketches and explains steric access and carbocation stabilization, including the neopentyl counterexample. Understanding electron-pair source, electrophilic carbon, leaving-group pair and charge conservation is a genuine common foundation. The whole 3899 body supplies exactly that basis through the specified bromoethane/chloroethane substitution models and the reversed-arrow correction. It does not require the old broader particular product routine. This is a content-based explicit role judgment, not automatic scope import from requires.

3899 explicitly limits net-equation inference: changing the halogen alone establishes neither definite rate nor SN1/SN2. Thus its support role preserves a4’s separate mechanism, steric and induction obligations; it supplies no automatic full a4 performance and no claimed universal substitution product or kinetic outcome. The role changes neither profile nor its existing evidence requirements; no additional task quota is imposed by this review.

The explicitly authored scope remains DE-NW Gymnasium CrossStage LK. The root entry selects prerequisiteOnly and remains outside the visible target tree. It therefore provides the canonical ID for prerequisite checks while leaving all 173 targets, their placement and progress/completion scope unchanged. The role is not inferred from the Q1 compatibility phase or GK/LK tags and does not create a GK, SekII-only, other-state or official whole-source target claim.

Appending a direct prerequisiteOnly goalEntry at the neutral root is a fitting existing authoring mechanism. The current whole view lacks a neutral support container; putting it into the Ethanol support branch would suggest an unrelated parent. Stock normalization/compilation and the current contract schema accept the exact root entry. No new runtime semantics or content duplication is required.

This exact addition resolves the absence of the a4→3899 reference in the declared role universe: direct missing rows decrease 7→6. It does not acquire or infer missing learner mastery. If 3899 is unmastered, a4’s prerequisite remains open; prerequisiteOnly alone supplies no new visible learner acquisition route. Existing global mastery remains untouched. The remaining six inherited missing rows and all other views are outside this verdict; no whole-view prerequisite closure or whole-view scientific PASS is claimed.
